svg.title: Single-shot prompting vs spec-driven agentic workflow
svg.desc: Light-themed infographic with explicit borders. Cards use white fill with slate borders. Outcome panels are tinted with matching colored borders. Left coral path: you, build me X, LLM, output, restart loop. Right teal path: spec.md, coordinator, two implementors plus verifier, substrate strip with spec.md context skills memory, verified output, feedback curve back to spec.md.
